A1.justification: Both complete, readable 27-page PDFs describe the same predictive variational inference work and include Appendices A–E. Text, equations, tables, and figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original election analyses, cryoEM simulations, seven-model predictive benchmarks, and supplementary regression experiments.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical studies, including the benchmark tables and appendix experiments, with revised cryoEM results in Figure 5.

M1.justification: The PVI objectives, regularizers, variational families, gradient estimators, and likelihood-free implementation remain unchanged. Changes to prior and expected-score notation do not alter the method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same election data, HSP90 simulations, seven posteriordb models, and normal/regression simulations. Figure 5 retains the same SNR and sample-size coverage.

E2.justification: The corresponding experiments retain the same VI/Bayes comparisons and the NPE and NRE baselines in Appendix C.2. Newly cited related methods are not added to experimental comparisons.

E3.justification: Reported splits, metrics, training schedules, Monte Carlo sample sizes, and model configurations remain unchanged in Section 4 and Appendices D–E. No setting change is documented alongside the revised Figure 5 results.

E4.justification: Figure 5 revises the existing analysis of cryoEM sensitivity to SNR and sample size: the updated curves show weaker SNR dependence, especially for N=100. Election diagnostics and the appendix regularization and misspecification analyses remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Both retain five-seed means and standard deviations in Tables 2–3 and 50 simulations in Figure 2. Figure 5 changes error-bar extents, but introduces no new reporting practice, run-count disclosure, or statistical procedure.

E6.justification: Figure 5 changes the N=100 and N=1000 KS-statistic curves and error bars. At SNR approximately 0.13, the plotted N=100 K rises from approximately 0.098 to 0.161, and its overall curve becomes nearly flat. The right panel, other figures, and benchmark tables retain their results.

T1.justification: The propositions, corollaries, assumptions, and proof arguments are retained. Section 2.1 introduces equivalent notation for the existing expected score, while Appendix A.1 replaces the inconsistent symbol pi with p_true; these are notation corrections rather than mathematical revisions.

C1.justification: The central claims remain predictive optimization beyond ordinary Bayes, implicit hierarchical expansion, heterogeneity diagnosis, and applicability to likelihood-exact and likelihood-free models.

C2.justification: Interpretations of heterogeneity and population uncertainty, finite-sample regularization benefits, and IID limitations remain unchanged. The existing uniqueness caveat for diagnostic use only receives a corrected cross-reference.

D1.justification: Appendix D retains the hardware, optimizers, learning-rate schedules, flow configurations, simulation details, and preprocessing information. Code/access disclosures are unchanged; standardizing prior notation adds no implementation detail.

R1.justification: v2 adds Masegosa (2020), Sheth and Khardon (2017, 2020), and Jankowiak et al. (2020). Section 5 connects PVI to PAC-Bayes and Gaussian-process predictive-loss optimization, emphasizing its broader model and scoring-rule scope.

P1.justification: Limited copyediting standardizes terminology and notation and corrects objective references from Equation 9 to Equation 4. Section 4.3 correctly redirects readers to Table 2, but Appendix C.3 incorrectly changes its full-results pointer from Table 3 to Table 2. The overall structure is retained.

P2.justification: Figure 5's left-panel curves and error bars are redrawn with unchanged axes, legend, caption, and panel arrangement. Text reflows across pages, including Section 5 moving below Table 2; no figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: Added discussion of closely related research and clearer notation and objective references modestly improve positioning and readability. These gains are partly offset by the incorrect Appendix C.3 table pointer. The unexplained Figure 5 revisions do not establish stronger empirical evidence, so the overall improvement is limited.
